entities.summary: Ruth Klüger was Professor Emerita of German Studies at the University of California, Irvine and a Holocaust survivor. She was the author of the bestseller Weiter leben: Eine Jugend  about her childhood in Vienna and in Nazi concentration camps.

entities.summary: Ruth Klüger was Professor Emerita of German Studies at the University of California, Irvine and a Holocaust survivor. She was the author of the bestseller Weiter leben: Eine Jugend  about her childhood in Vienna and in Nazi concentration camps.
